scenario_hypotheses.description: Primary candidate: the test uses the default-base branch with an empty getFrom Optional, a Java version at most 8, an empty custom entrypoint, processor stubs returning the expected entrypoint and classes layer, empty collection options, and absent/default-equivalent optional setters.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getFrom() is empty; getJavaVersion() returns <= 8; getEntrypoint().isEmpty(); computeEntrypoint() returns the asserted four-element list; createLayers() returns the asserted layer; collection getters yield empty inputs.

scenario_hypotheses.description: Alternative explicit-from candidate: getFrom() is present, so ContainerBuilders.create builds the builder; provided it returns the same base image and compatible builder defaults, the visible plan can match without calling processor.getJavaVersion().
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getFrom() is present and ContainerBuilders.create produces the asserted base image and a builder whose defaults satisfy the visible assertions.

scenario_hypotheses.description: Alternative custom-entrypoint candidate: getFrom() is empty and Java <= 8, but getEntrypoint() returns the asserted four-element list directly; processor.computeEntrypoint() is not called.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getFrom() is empty; getJavaVersion() returns <= 8; getEntrypoint() is non-empty and exactly the asserted entrypoint.

dependency_constraints.statement: When getFrom() is absent, the base image branch selects adoptopenjdk:8-jre only if getJavaVersion() is <= 8; a value greater than 8 selects adoptopenjdk:11-jre and cannot satisfy the visible base-image assertion.
processor.createLayers() is called unconditionally, and its returned list is passed unchanged to setFileEntriesLayers; therefore the final plan's layer data originates from createLayers().
dependency_constraints.condition: toJibContainerBuilder executes normally and reaches the layer assignment.

dependency_constraints.statement: If getEntrypoint() is empty, the entrypoint is computed by processor.computeEntrypoint(jarOptions.getJvmFlags()); otherwise the custom list is used directly.
The values from getExposedPorts(), getVolumes(), getEnvironment(), and getLabels() are passed to the corresponding builder setters; non-empty values would appear in the asserted plan collections.
dependency_constraints.condition: toJibContainerBuilder executes normally and the plan collections remain empty.

dependency_constraints.statement: getUser(), getFormat(), and getCreationTime() are applied only when their Optional is present; a null user requires getUser() to be empty, while format Docker and creation time EPOCH may come from absent values or present default-equivalent values.
dependency_constraints.condition: The masked option setup is not visible.

dependency_constraints.statement: processor.getJavaVersion() is evaluated only on the absent-getFrom branch; the explicit-from branch uses ContainerBuilders.create instead.
dependency_constraints.condition: The branch selected by getFrom() follows the source control flow.

expected_interactions.statement: On S1, commonContainerConfigCliOptions.getFrom() is checked, and because it is empty, processor.getJavaVersion() is evaluated to choose the base image.
processor.createLayers() is invoked, and its result is supplied to containerBuilder.setFileEntriesLayers(...).
commonContainerConfigCliOptions.getEntrypoint() is invoked; when it is empty, jarOptions.getJvmFlags() is evaluated and passed to processor.computeEntrypoint(...).
On the custom-entrypoint alternative, processor.computeEntrypoint(...) is not called and the custom entrypoint list is used directly.
commonContainerConfigCliOptions.getExposedPorts(), getVolumes(), getEnvironment(), getLabels(), and getProgramArguments() are invoked and passed to the corresponding builder setters.
commonContainerConfigCliOptions.getUser(), getFormat(), and getCreationTime() are invoked, and their setters are applied only if the returned Optional is present.

evidence.quote:
JibContainerBuilder containerBuilder =
        JarFiles.toJibContainerBuilder(
            mockStandardExplodedProcessor,
            mockJarCommand,
            mockCommonCliOptions,
            mockCommonContainerConfigCliOptions,
            mockLogger);
    ContainerBuildPlan buildPlan = containerBuilder.toContainerBuildPlan();
evidence.rationale: Shows the method under test is called with five mocks and the resulting builder is converted to a ContainerBuildPlan for the assertions.
Directly states the visible assertions for base image, platforms, creation time, and format.
Directly states the visible assertions for empty collections, null user, and null working directory.
Directly states the visible entrypoint size and contents.

evidence.quote:
assertEquals(1, buildPlan.getLayers().size());
    assertEquals("classes", buildPlan.getLayers().get(0).getName());
    assertArrayEquals(
        FileEntriesLayer.builder()
            .addEntry(
                Paths.get("path/to/tempDirectory/class1.class"),
                AbsoluteUnixPath.get("/app/explodedJar/class1.class"))
            .build()
            .getEntries()
            .toArray(new Object[0]),
        ((FileEntriesLayer) buildPlan.getLayers().get(0)).getEntries().toArray(new Object[0]));
    assertEquals(
        AbsoluteUnixPath.get("/app/explodedJar/class1.class"),
        ((FileEntriesLayer) buildPlan.getLayers().get(0)).getEntries().get(0).getExtractionPath());
evidence.rationale: Directly states the visible assertions for the single classes layer, its entries, and the entry extraction path.
Shows a local layer named classes with the class1.class entry, a plausible value for the masked createLayers stub.
Shows the mock setup region is masked, so exact stubbed dependency behavior is not visible.
Shows the verification region is masked and empty, so no visible call verification is stated.
Shows the explicit-from branch versus the default branch, including the getJavaVersion() <= 8 condition selecting adoptopenjdk:8-jre.
Shows createLayers() is passed to setFileEntriesLayers and shows entrypoint selection from either computeEntrypoint(...) or a non-empty custom entrypoint.
Shows collection options are passed to builder setters and user, format, and creation time are applied only when their Optionals are present.
Shows the permitted processor method signatures in the supporting source throw in their bodies, so the test's actual dependency returns must come from masked mocks rather than these method bodies.

uncertainty.statement: The exact mock stubbing in the MOCK-STUB region is not visible, so the configured dependency return values cannot be confirmed from supplied text.
The adoptopenjdk:8-jre base could come either from an absent getFrom() with getJavaVersion() <= 8 or from a present getFrom() whose ContainerBuilders.create result is the same base image.

The four-element entrypoint could come either from processor.computeEntrypoint(...) when the custom entrypoint is empty or directly from a non-empty getEntrypoint() list; the masked setup does not reveal which.

How platforms amd64/linux and the null working directory are established is not shown in the JarFiles source; they may be builder defaults from Jib or ContainerBuilders.create, but the supplied target source does not determine that.

Whether getUser(), getFormat(), and getCreationTime() return empty Optionals or present default-equivalent values is hidden; either can be consistent with the visible null user, Docker format, and EPOCH creation time.
The exact return value of createLayers() is not visible; it could be the local layer variable shown before the masked stub or another equivalent layer list, as long as the visible assertions match.

The supporting StandardExplodedProcessor source contains method bodies that throw UnsupportedOperationException; because the test passes a mock processor, these bodies do not determine the stubbed return values.
No visible verification assertions are present in the masked VERIFY-START/END region, so any verification candidate would lack visible textual support.
